newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Kuala Lumpur tin down on LME's fall.
newsitem.headline: Kuala Lumpur tin down on LME's fall.

text.p: Malaysia's spot tin price fell six cents to 13.79 ringgit ($5.38) a kg on Wednesday after players sold heavily on the metal due to an overnight slump on the London Metal Exchange (LME), traders said.
The weaker ringgit against the U.S. dollar still made Malaysian tin attractive, said the traders. "But the LME tin was down too sharply, so our market had to follow," said a trader.
The local price was at a premium of $15 a tonne against the LME after being on par on Tuesday.
Traders noted initial bids for 68 tonnes against offers for 139. Final turnover was 71 tonnes, down from 217 on Tuesday, and was absorbed by Europeans, Japanese and locals.
